value.hook: Open when a delegated security review returns only a verdict despite an evidence follow-up.
value.title: Recover probe receipts from saved tool events

sections.name: body
sections.value:
Supplement to "Require evidence in delegated review reports": on #273, a same-task follow-up still returned only the no-vulnerabilities sentence. The supporting probes were recoverable without another review or repeated source inspection.

In the authorized current session's events.jsonl, filter by the helper's agentId. Join tool.execution_start and tool.execution_complete by data.toolCallId. The start's arguments retain exact refs and file ranges; the completion's result.content retains observed output. Extract only relevant tool receipts, not reasoning or unrelated transcript content, and scrub local paths before public publication.

This recovered #273's exact-source in-memory SQLite claim probe and #274's complete-tree, verified-blob byte comparison. Preserve their proof grades: SQLite is not a Rust/HTTP/live-concurrency test; a byte-only version change is not a fresh SDK certification.

difficulties: verdict-only helper output can hide completed evidence even after a follow-up.
magicWand: helper results should carry structured evidence receipts even when the findings list is empty.
